svg.title: Voltara Divine — Litany of Lightning. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Lightning classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Anointed by Lightning forks into Luminous Conduit then Apotheosis of Thunder. Halo of Static forks into Dragon's Whispered Wrath then Ethereal Dragon Unbound, or Aegis of Living Light then Unassailable Radiance. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Lightning jutsu.

two self rows)","secondary":"Lightning burst \u2014 Damage (Bind 40, Whispers 50 EP): a controlled +2 payoff on each strike's own cast, Whispers 50 \u2192 52 above the Nuke tier","tertiary":"Blitz guard \u2014 Decrease Damage Taken (Voltara Blitz; one self row, the fortress route)","rationale":"Five supported rows sit on three casts. Both Lightning strikes carry a 35% self Increase Damage Given row that is live the two rounds after the cast and never on its own hit: Bind's carries Lightning and amplifies only Lightning hits, Whispers' carries no element and lists all four stat types, so it amplifies every non-pierce hit the caster lands; one cast therefore drives many later hits, and the 15% Lightning passive multiplies last. That is the bloodline's highest-leverage lever and takes the primary route. The two strikes (Bind 40 EP, Whispers 50 EP; 60 AP each, so never in one turn; cooldowns 6 and 7, single target) take a controlled +2 Damage on the burst route, the only bonus that acts on a strike's own cast. Voltara Blitz (60 AP, cooldown 7) carries the caster in and leaves a 30% self Decrease Damage Taken row for 2 rounds, the kit's only defence and its only answer to the 10% Wind Increase Damage Taken passive; it roots the fortress route and opens the burst sequence (Blitz, Bind, Whispers). BUFF","adverse":false,"base":35.0,"gain":2,"final":37.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Unassailable Radiance"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has three supported tags on five rows (Increase Damage Given x2, Damage x2, Decrease Damage Taken x1; Blitz's move and pierce and Bind's stun are unsupported). A fourth Advanced Art would twin a capstone on the same rows or push Blitz's single Decrease Damage Taken row past +10%. Anointed by Lightning therefore runs one chain (Luminous Conduit \u2192 Apotheosis of Thunder) and Halo of Static is universal: it is in every legal 4 BP build, so the Amplification build is fixed (01, 04, 05 + 06) and every build carries +2% Decrease Damage Taken. A second leaf under Anointed by Lightning could only repeat Increase Damage Given on the two self rows (the twin this layout removes), and the pre-batch Heaven's Retort leaf (+2 Damage on a Hidden Art) is not restored.","design_notes":["Structure: edges 01\u219204\u219205, 06\u219202\u219203 and 06\u219207\u219208. Anointed by Lightning +2% \u2192 Luminous Conduit +2% \u2192 Apotheosis of Thunder +4% Increase Damage Given (amplification, both self buffs 43%). Halo of Static (+2% Decrease Damage Taken on Blitz) forks into Dragon's Whispered Wrath +2% Increase Damage Given \u2192 Ethereal Dragon Unbound +2 Damage (burst) and Aegis of Living Light +3% \u2192 Unassailable Radiance +5% Decrease Damage Taken (Blitz guard 40%). Eight legal 4 BP builds, seven non-dominated. Maxima over every legal allocation: Increase Damage Given +8% (Apotheosis of Thunder with Halo of Static), Decrease Damage Taken +10%, Damage +2 (Ethereal Dragon Unbound only).","Damage (final cleanup, R1\u2032): kept as a controlled +2 because the kit is strike-led. Its two single-target Lightning strikes carry all four offensive supported rows, and Ethereal Dragon's Whispers is the signature finisher: the kit's only B-rank jutsu (Bind and Blitz are D), its only 50 EP row, landing inside Luminous Illusion Bind's 2-round stun and Lightning window. Without it the third route has no distinct identity: only Increase Damage Given and Decrease Damage Taken remain, each already owned by a capstone.","Burst against amplification is immediacy against window: flat Damage acts on the strike's own cast, the buffs never do, and Bind and Whispers (60 AP each) cannot share a turn. The burst sequence is Blitz, Bind, Whispers: Halo of Static's guard covers both strike turns and Bind's window carries Whispers' 52. The +2 reaches every Lightning Damage row, so Burst with Anointed by Lightning leads on the strike pair (42 + 52 \u00d7 1.39 = 114.3 against 40 + 50 \u00d7 1.43 = 111.5 EP-equivalent), on any Lightning strike outside a window (42/52 against 40/50) and on an off-kit 40 EP Lightning jutsu hit in one window (42 \u00d7 1.39 = 58.4 against 40 \u00d7 1.43 = 57.2). Apotheosis of Thunder leads on windowed hits the +2 does not reach (weapons, basic attacks, other-element jutsu: \u00d71.43 against \u00d71.39, about 2.9%) and, by about 0.8%, on an off-kit 40 EP Lightning jutsu hit in the overlap round, when both strikes are on cooldown (40 \u00d7 1.43\u00b2 = 81.8 against 42 \u00d7 1.39\u00b2 = 81.1). Per pair, Burst stays ahead with one other non-Lightning hit worth 40 EP in the windows (169.9 against 168.7) and the routes tie with two (225.5 against 225.9); with two off-kit 40 EP Lightning hits (one in the overlap round, one in Whispers' window only) Burst leads 253.8 against 250.5.","Magnitudes: the amplification route is +8% on two rows that compound on a hit in their overlap round (\u2248 \u00d71.122 there, below Blood-Enchanted Eyes' \u00d71.234 top package), split 2/2/4 so the capstone carries the payoff. Dragon's Whispered Wrath hangs from Halo of Static, so it is never Apotheosis of Thunder's fourth purchase and Increase Damage Given stays at +8% over every legal allocation (the earlier layout's capstone plus sibling setup reached +10%, \u2248 \u00d71.154). Unassailable Radiance keeps +10% because Blitz's row is the kit's only defence and is live 2 rounds in 7 (damage taken \u00d70.60 against \u00d70.70, \u2248 \u00d70.86).","Timing (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73b): each Increase Damage Given and Decrease Damage Taken row is live the two rounds after its cast, never on its own strike; Bind then Whispers (or the reverse) gives the second strike the first strike's row. Blitz's guard is realized on the caster at cast."],"risks":["Classification: Lightning is shared with other bloodlines (expected under RUL-2026-10-03-005). Whispers' Increase Damage Given and Blitz's Decrease Damage Taken carry no element and need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver; Voltara Blitz (no Lightning row) qualifies in-kit only through an authored Lightning jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit Lightning coverage is unverified, and Ethereal Dragon Unbound's +2 Damage reaches every Lightning Damage row in it.","Broad self amplification: at up to 43% Whispers' row multiplies every non-pierce hit the caster lands for 2 rounds (weapons, basic attacks, normal jutsu) and Bind's every Lightning hit, off-kit Lightning jutsu included, with the 15% passive on top; the amplification route is the highest-leverage route. Not simulated.","Ally-targeted casts: Bind and Whispers (OTHER_USER) accept any living non-caster user in range 4 / 3 (util.ts 2747\u20132749). On an ally the Damage and stun rows (ENEMIES) are withheld but the SELF Increase Damage Given row is still realized (actions.ts 1060\u20131067), so with an ally present the buff can be taken without landing a strike; that favours amplification over burst. Not simulated.","Guard is one row at 2 rounds in 7, and Blitz is a 60 AP displacement cast, so the fortress and the burst sequence it opens also commit position. Skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in ranked PvP / sparring at the pin."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":8,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":3,"advanced_art_count":3,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":4,"3":7,"4":8},"full_budget_allocations":8,"non_dominated_full_allocations":7,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":8,"decreasedamagetaken":10},"supported_rows_in_kit":5,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":2,"decreasedamagetaken":1,"increasedamagegiven":2},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Fable proposal \u2014 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Lightning classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).","Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Lightning jutsu. Off-kit jutsu of the element are in scope by rule; their count is unverified. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.","Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.","Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."],"ceilings":{"maximum_over_all_legal_allocations":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":8,"decreasedamagetaken":10},"ceilings":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":10,"decreasedamagetaken":10},"hard_ceilings":{"damage":5,"lifesteal":5,"afterburn":15},"default_ceiling":10,"route_bands":[5,10,15],"routes":[{"advanced_art":"03","name":"Ethereal Dragon Unbound","primary_tag":"damage","path":["06","02","03"],"steps":[0,0,2],"total":2,"on_band":false},{"advanced_art":"05","name":"Apotheosis of Thunder","primary_tag":"increasedamagegiven","path":["01","04","05"],"steps":[2,2,4],"total":8,"on_band":false},{"advanced_art":"08","name":"Unassailable Radiance","primary_tag":"decreasedamagetaken","path":["06","07","08"],"steps":[2,3,5],"total":10,"on_band":true}],"director_exceptions":[]}},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","02","03","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":4,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","06"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":6,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","07"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":4,"decreasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":8,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":4,"decreasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["01","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":10}},{"ids":["02","03","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["02","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":10}}],"design_review":{"status":"Fable proposal (2026-10-04 batch rebalance, roster pass); not director-approved","foundation_sentences":{"01":"How do I amplify every blow in the windows my strikes open?","06":"How do I fight from where the blitz lands me: hold the ground, or strike from it?"},"route_identities":{"03":"burst: Lightning window setup on the Hidden Art, controlled +2 Damage payoff on Bind's and Whispers' own casts (sequence Blitz, Bind, Whispers)","05":"sustained amplification: both self buffs at 43%, every non-pierce hit in Whispers' window, every Lightning hit in Bind's","08":"fortress: Blitz guard at 40%, the kit's only defence"},"director_review":"Roster questions: DQ-A (Ethereal Dragon's Whispers 50 \u2192 52, Luminous Illusion Bind 40 \u2192 42, on the strike-led reading in above_nuke_rationale); DQ-H (9 \u2192 8 nodes; Dragon's Whispered Wrath \u2192 Ethereal Dragon Unbound now hang from Halo of Static, so the burst setup is never Apotheosis of Thunder's fourth purchase).","concerns":["R1\u2032 reading: Damage is kept because the kit is strike-led, but Ethereal Dragon's Whispers shares 60 AP with every kit cast and cooldown 7 with Voltara Blitz, so the finisher reading rests on its B rank and its place after Bind's stun, not on cost. If the director reads the kit as amplification-led, Damage goes unamplified and, with only Increase Damage Given and Decrease Damage Taken left, the tree drops to two routes (six nodes) rather than gain a duplicate capstone.","Halo of Static is universal (in all 8 legal 4 BP builds) and the Amplification build is fixed (01, 04, 05 + 06); Unassailable Radiance's two fourths, Anointed by Lightning and Dragon's Whispered Wrath, give the same +2%.","Burst and amplification stay close in total throughput. Burst with Anointed by Lightning leads on the strike pair, on off-kit Lightning jutsu hits outside the overlap round, and with one other non-Lightning hit in the windows per pair; the two tie at two non-Lightning hits (225.5 against 225.9) and Amplification leads from three (283.1 against 281.1). Amplification's case is weapon, basic-attack and other-element hits in the windows (\u00d71.43 against \u00d71.39) and, by about 0.8%, an off-kit 40 EP Lightning jutsu hit in the overlap round."]},"above_nuke_rationale":"Ethereal Dragon Unbound's controlled +2 Damage lifts Ethereal Dragon's Whispers 50 \u2192 52, past the 50 Nuke tier. Kit reason (R1\u2032): the dossier lists no traits, but the kit is strike-led (its two single-target Lightning strikes carry all four offensive supported rows) and Whispers is its signature finisher: the kit's only B-rank jutsu (Bind and Blitz are D) and its only 50 EP row, landing inside Luminous Illusion Bind's 2-round stun and Lightning window. It is the payoff of a deliberate burst route (Halo of Static \u2192 Dragon's Whispered Wrath's +2% self Increase Damage Given setup \u2192 Ethereal Dragon Unbound), the pattern the director kept on Blood-Enchanted Eyes (RUL-2026-10-04-001, Reaper's Embrace 50 \u2192 52) and Shakunetsu Sakura (RUL-2026-10-04-002, Sakura-ame 50 \u2192 52). It is the tree's only Damage node, so no legal allocation adds more than +2 and none without the capstone passes 50 (Luminous Illusion Bind 40 \u2192 42 stays Normal). Fable proposal; flagged for director confirmation (DQ-A)."}

g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Lightning jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Ethereal Dragon Unbound path + Anointed by Lightning
Apotheosis of Thunder path + Halo of Static
Unassailable Radiance path + Anointed by Lightning
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE VOLTARA DIVINE KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Lightning classification / forked tree
